question: As per Census 2011, which of the following is the most populated city in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mumbai** is the most populated city in India as per the **Census 2011**.
 
• The city's population was recorded at approximately **12.4 million**.
 
• Mumbai is located in the state of **Maharashtra** and is often referred to as the **financial capital of India**.
